parts: Please review the work in /shifted-zeta-positivity/papers/investigations/ccm-fractal-laplacians, and continue with the next steps
I’ll review the investigation, its open questions, and the repository guidance, then work through the next research steps and save the findings in the project.

The existing work gives a sound control example with logarithmic spectral growth, but the arithmetic connection remains conditional. I’m now testing the proposed next step at \(L=\log 13\): whether the actual CCM forms at cutoffs \(4,8,16\) support the required positive graph energy, mass, and compatible refinement maps.

The main issue is sharper than spectral growth: a positive matrix need not be a resistance energy in the proposed geometric coordinates. I’m checking an analytic obstruction caused by folding prime jumps into the odd sector, alongside the finite computations and a separate test of whether the CCM mass can come from a positive measure.

The finite tests now show three failures of the prescribed interpretation: positive off-diagonal stiffness entries, negative mass entries in the proposed harmonic vertex coordinates, and failure of a pointwise identity that any measure-based sine mass must satisfy. The inverse traces do increase, so that necessary check passes. I also have an analytic sign obstruction that does not depend on numerical precision.

The 80- and 120-digit runs agree on all 153 saved numerical observables. I’m documenting the precise scope: this rules out the tested logarithmic-coordinate construction, not every possible fractal realization. The new analytic example explains how an ordinary positive prime jump becomes a sign-reversing coupling after odd folding.

The review and continuation note are drafted. They include the analytic proof, the failed stiffness and mass tests, and the checks that passed. I’m checking reproducibility and file links before saving them into the investigation, with the earlier notes and records preserved.

Reviewed the investigation and completed the proposed \(L=\log13\), \(N=4,8,16\) experiment.

The existing tree and trace arguments survived review. **The tested arithmetic graph construction fails** its stiffness, mass, and refinement requirements. I also proved an analytic obstruction: odd folding of prime jumps violates the Markov property, regardless of the scalar ground shift. This rules out the prescribed interpretation, not every fractal realization.

The 80- and 120-digit runs agree on all 153 saved numerical observables; these computations are not interval certificates.

Saved the [continuation note](/Users/ebbaker/Documents/shifted-zeta-positivity/papers/investigations/ccm-fractal-laplacians/notes/CCM_PRIME_JUMP_GEOMETRY_OBSTRUCTIONS_20260926.md), [critical review](/Users/ebbaker/Documents/shifted-zeta-positivity/papers/investigations/ccm-fractal-laplacians/reviews/PRIME_JUMP_GEOMETRY_CRITICAL_REVIEW_20260926.md), and reproducible numerics. Updated the guides and history index.

The next focused test is the even integrated map \(q\mapsto Jq\). Changes are saved but uncommitted.
